# Seoul Weekend Plan: 3 Days for Museums, Street Food, and Easy Walking

A relaxed, culture-forward itinerary for **2 adults** with light transit, walkable neighborhoods, and good food stops. Budget is kept within **₩900,000 total** excluding international flights.

## Day-by-Day Seoul Itinerary

### Day 1: Historic Seoul + Gwangjang Food Crawl
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Gyeongbokgung Palace and the National Folk Museum area; easy walking, photo stops, and a calm start.
- **Afternoon:** Bukchon Hanok Village to Samcheong-dong for galleries, cafes, and short scenic streets.
- **Evening:** Gwangjang Market for bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, tteokbokki, and a low-effort dinner.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d8/Dongdaemun_Shopping_Complex%2C_Seoul_2.jpg Alt=Evening:** Gwangjang Market for bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, tteokbokki, and a low-effort dinner, Seoul, South Korea
- **Estimated transit:** **₩18,000** total
- **Estimated food:** **₩85,000** total
- **Day total:** **₩103,000**

### Day 2: Museum Day in Yongsan + Riverside Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Morning:** National Museum of Korea for major Korean art and history collections.
- **Afternoon:** Leeum Museum of Art or nearby Yongsan park/cafe break, depending on energy level.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b7/2011-02-01_Paintings_by_Michael_Lin_in_Leeum_Museum.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Leeum Museum of Art or nearby Yongsan park/cafe break, depending on energy level, Seoul, South Korea
- **Evening:** Itaewon or nearby neighborhood dinner, then a gentle Han River walk if weather is clear.
- **Estimated transit:** **₩20,000** total
- **Estimated food:** **₩95,000** total
- **Day total:** **₩115,000**

### Day 3: Contemporary Seoul + Market Snacks
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Morning:** Dongdaemun Design Plaza area and nearby design shops or exhibitions.
- **Afternoon:** Insadong for crafts, tea houses, and a slow walk through cultural streets.
- **Evening:** Myeongdong street food dinner and shopping stroll before wrapping up.
- **Estimated transit:** **₩18,000** total
- **Estimated food:** **₩90,000** total
- **Day total:** **₩108,000**

## Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Transit for 3 days | ₩56,000 |
| Food and drinks for 3 days | ₩270,000 |
| Museum admissions and small entry fees | ₩80,000 |
| Local taxis / ride-hail buffer | ₩60,000 |
| Coffee, snacks, extras | ₩60,000 |
| Contingency buffer | ₩150,000 |
| **Estimated trip total** | **₩676,000** |

**Budget fit:** This plan stays comfortably under your **₩900,000** cap, leaving room for nicer dinners, shopping, or an extra taxi ride.

## Rainy-Day Backup: Indoor Seoul Museum Loop

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
If rain changes the plan, switch to this mostly indoor route:
- **Morning:** National Museum of Korea
- **Afternoon:** Leeum Museum of Art or Seoul Museum of Craft Art
- **Evening:** COEX Mall / Starfield Library area for easy indoor wandering and dinner

**Backup cost estimate**
- Transit: **₩16,000**
- Food: **₩85,000**
- Entry fees: **₩40,000–₩70,000**

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Check museum hours](https://english.visitseoul.net/)
Action: [Button: Plan transit routes](https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Seoul)
Action: [Button: Browse Seoul food spots](https://english.visitseoul.net/food)

## Sources
- Seoul tourism guide: https://english.visitseoul.net/
- Korea travel information: https://english.visitkorea.or.kr/
- Transit planning reference: https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Seoul
